component.name: OnedriveLinux
component.summary: A GUI for the OneDrive Client for Linux, with multi-account support

description.p: Manage and monitor several OneDrive and SharePoint accounts synced by the OneDrive Client for Linux (abraunegg/onedrive): start and stop sync, follow transfers live, and edit each account's client options. A Rust and egui port of the Python OneDriveGUI.
